targets.rawSql: SELECT 'site' AS "Mode",p.site_key AS "Site Key",p.site_name AS "Data Center",p.core_switch_a AS "Core Switch A",p.core_switch_b AS "Core Switch B",p.access_switch AS "Access Switch",p.switch_interface AS "Switch Interface",p.server_key AS "Server Key",p.server_name AS "Server",p.server_interface AS "Server Interface",initcap(p.redundancy_role) AS "Redundancy Role",p.vlan_id::text AS "VLAN",p.vlan_name AS "VLAN Name",initcap(p.connection_status) AS "Status",s.servers AS "Servers",s.virtual_machines AS "VMs",s.k8s_clusters AS "K8s Clusters",s.k8s_nodes AS "K8s Nodes",s.k8s_pods AS "Pods",s.applications AS "Applications" FROM inventory.site_physical_connectivity_overview p JOIN inventory.site_full_stack_topology_overview s ON s.site_key=p.site_key WHERE p.site_key='${site:raw}' ORDER BY p.server_key,p.redundancy_role

list.definition: SELECT name AS __text,site_key AS __value FROM inventory.sites ORDER BY name
